en: Figure 1: Three limitations of Trace2Skill-style methods and the corresponding SkillCAT solutions.
zh: 图 1：Trace2Skill 类方法的三项局限及 SkillCAT 对应的解决方案。

en: Figure 2: Overview of SkillCAT pipeline, comprising three key components: (1) CCE extracts same-task contrastive evidence by comparing successful and failed trajectories, (2) AAE validates candidate patches and merges only the helpful ones into the skill, and (3) TTE organizes the skill into a routable topology and retrieves task-relevant nodes for agent execution.
zh: 图 2：SkillCAT 流程概览，由三个关键组件组成：(1) CCE 通过比较成功和失败轨迹提取同一任务的对比证据；(2) AAE 验证候选补丁，并仅将有益补丁合并到技能中；(3) TTE 将技能组织为可路由的拓扑，并检索与任务相关的节点供智能体执行。

en: Figure 3: Multimodal evaluation on DocVQA. Skills authored by Qwen3.5-35B-A3B are tested with matched and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B users.
zh: 图 3：DocVQA 上的多模态评估。使用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 编写的技能分别由匹配模型和 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 使用者进行测试。

en: Figure 4: Additional analyses of CCE, AAE, and TTE. (a) CCE accuracy and sampling cost across different numbers of trajectories. (b) AAE bucket accuracy by replay transition, with Trace2Skill as the reference. (c) Accuracy and context reduction of embedding and LLM graph routing across Top-k. All results are from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on SpreadsheetBench.
zh: 图 4：对 CCE、AAE 和 TTE 的补充分析。(a) 不同轨迹数量下 CCE 的准确率和采样成本。(b) 按重放转变类别统计的 AAE 分桶准确率，以 Trace2Skill 为参照。(c) 不同 Top-k 下，基于嵌入和基于 LLM 的图路由在准确率及上下文缩减方面的表现。所有结果均来自 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在 SpreadsheetBench 上的实验。
